IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives McCune, Kretz, Warnick, and Bailey

Bill.BriefDescription: Including the study of the Pledge of Allegiance in high school graduation requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the study of the Pledge of Allegiance; andamending RCW 28A.230.170.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.230.170 and 2006 c 263 s 403 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The study of the Constitution of the United States, the Pledge ofAllegiance, and the Constitution of the state of Washington shall be acondition prerequisite to graduation from the public and private highschools of this state. The superintendent of public instruction shallprovide by rule for the implementation of this section.
